# Uncensored AI API on Muapi

A developer guide to Muapi's 21 abliterated, obliterated, and derestricted LLM endpoints.

- [README](README.md): overview, quickstart, API flow, compatibility, and project links
- [API reference](docs/API.md): authentication, request fields, async polling, SSE streaming, retries
- [Model catalog](docs/MODEL-CATALOG.md): endpoint IDs, input support, and dated token-price snapshot
- [OpenAI-compatible chat](docs/OPENAI-COMPATIBLE.md): shared chat endpoint, model discovery, SDK and streaming
- [Client integrations](docs/CLIENT-INTEGRATIONS.md): direct REST, OpenAI chat, Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode
- [Model selection](docs/MODEL-SELECTION.md): selection criteria and reproducible comparison method
- [Safety](docs/SAFETY.md): practical limitations and application safeguards
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md): common setup and troubleshooting questions
- [Muapi live catalog](https://muapi.ai/abliterated-llm-api): current model details and rates
- [Muapi API docs](https://muapi.ai/docs/api-reference): canonical API documentation
- [Get a Muapi API key](https://muapi.ai/access-keys)
